## **1\. System Overview**

The system is designed as an AI-powered technical interview simulator that allows users to interact with an AI interviewer, receive real-time feedback and improve their coding and communication skills. By simulating a real coding interview environment, users gain confidence and familiarity with high-stakes scenarios, helping them reduce interview anxiety. 

Users have the ability to select coding questions based on difficulty and topic and work on them in a code editor with syntax highlighting, ensuring that they can focus on their specific weak areas. The system simulates live coding interviews and provides real-time feedback on code correctness and structure based on optimal solutions for the respective problem, allowing them to improve quickly which makes practice sessions more impactful. After each session, users receive a performance summary with insights into their code and communication, allowing them to track their progress over time. This allows users to improve not only their technical skills, but also improve their ability to communicate in a professional setting.

## **2\. Technology**

### **Frontend Technologies**

* **Next.js**  
  * Offers both client side and server side rendering which allows for quick interviewer responses (client-side), in-depth evaluation of interview (server-side) and profile statistics/overview (server-side)  
  * Offers built-in API endpoints to simplify backend integration  
* **React.js with TypeScript**  
  * Provides strong typing, component reusability, and extensive ecosystem  
  * Used for building responsive UI components and managing application state  
  * State Management with React Context \+ Hooks \- Sufficient for our scale without Redux complexity  
* **ShadcnUI \+ Tailwind CSS**  
  * Enables rapid UI development with utility-first approach  
  * Provides consistent styling and responsive design capabilities  
  * Strong TypeScript support

  ### **Backend Technologies**

1. **FastAPI (Python)**  
* Asynchronous support for handling multiple real-time communications between APIs and the Frontend  
* Simpler learning curve given well written documentation  
* Strong typing with Pydantic   
* Better performance for the application compared to Django/Flask  
2. **MongoDB Atlas**  
* Easy to use with Native Typescript/Python [Drivers](https://www.mongodb.com/developer/products/atlas/quickstart-mongodb-atlas-python/)  
* Flexible schema for data structures  
* Scales well for document-based data storage  
3. **Redis**  
* Fast in memory caching for session data  
* Built-in support for rate limiting

  ### **Real-time Communications**

1. **Deepgram**  
* Superior real-time transcription accuracy  
* WebSocket support for streaming  
* Competitive pricing model  
* Good documentation and support  
2. **WebSocket**  
* Native browser support  
* Bi-directional communication  
* Lower latency than HTTP polling  
* Efficient for real-time updates

  ### **AI/ML**

1. **OpenAI API**  
* State-of-the-art language models  
* Robust API with good documentation  
* Function calling capabilities  
* Cost-effective for our use case

  ## **System Assumptions**

1. **Browser Compatibility**  
   * Modern browsers with WebSocket support  
   * WebRTC and MediaRecorder API support  
   * Local storage available for caching  
   * Minimum 1MB/s upload speed for audio streaming  
2. **User Permissions**  
   * Microphone access will be granted  
   * Local storage access allowed  
   * Camera access (for future video features)  
   * Cookie acceptance for session management  
3. **Infrastructure**  
   * MongoDB Atlas handles database scaling/backup  
   * Redis Cloud for managed Redis instance  
   * Vercel handles Next.js deployment/scaling  
   * OpenAI API maintains 99.9% uptime  
   * Deepgram maintains reliable WebSocket connections  
4. **Network Conditions**  
   * Maximum latency of 200ms for real-time features  
   * Stable internet connection during interviews  
   * Sufficient bandwidth for audio streaming  
5. **Security**  
   * HTTPS enabled for all communications  
   * CORS policies properly configured  
   * Rate limiting handled by Redis  
   * MongoDB Atlas security features active

## **5\. User Experience** 

For the user experience of the system, the speed of the system needs to be considered when it comes to the design decisions. Because of this, as indicated by the diagram above, the Real-Time Code Analysis of the system sends code incrementally through to the backend of the program to process the code. Processing the code incrementally, allows for the system to provide real-time and final feedback to the user within seconds of submission. This substantially decreases the perceived time to receive feedback on the code submission and will allow the users to complete more problems in a shorter amount of time, while also keeping the load on the system relatively minimal, due to the data being processed being much smaller than the entire code submission.

Other design decisions include a modern, relatively flat theme to all UI elements. This method of designing UI is inspired from modern UI systems such as iOS and Android, large operating systems used by millions of people. These systems utilize flat design, high contrast, and simple UI elements to allow users easy navigation throughout different areas of the system, easy to read information, consistent looks across screens, and visually appealing colors.
